subject: nimble in parallel when RAM use is high

messages.author: bfa4a88c8a5bc54e
messages.subject: nimble in parallel when RAM use is high
parts:
Hi all,

Pardon me if this isn't necessarily a nimble issue.

I'm interested in running a big model in parallel using the instructions on the nimble website. The model I want to use it for uses huge amounts of RAM and nearly maxes out the machine we're using. Most of this RAM use comes up during buildMCMC() and subsequently compileNimble(); the RAM use is quite manageable during the MCMC sampling. I'm assuming here that running these steps in parallel will increase the RAM use of the machine.

Is it possible to do the model and MCMC building sequentially, while doing the MCMC step in parallel? 

Thanks!

Matt

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: nimble in parallel when RAM use is high
parts:
Here's one idea. Set it up to do it in parallel, but in your function that is run in parallel include a Sys.sleep() call that is set up so that the different chains are offset in terms of when the memory-intensity steps start.

Alternatively run the chains in completely independent R sessions and make sure to offset the starting times as needed.

-Chris
